factErrors: Preset scalene-centroid is misnamed: AB² = 7²+1² = 50 and BC² = (-5)²+5² = 50, so the given triangle is isosceles, not scalene.
Beat triangle misconception: the claim that “only the height is kept” is literally false; AB is fixed because A and B are fixed, and the hints also correctly state that the area is constant.

For preset scalene-centroid, beats move/special and frame 4 falsely say the center may leave the triangle or reach a vertex. For every nondegenerate triangle the centroid G=(A+B+C)/3 lies strictly inside.

Frame 4 and the special hints apply H=A and the orthocenter's right-angle-vertex case to scalene-centroid and acute-circum. This silently changes the selected center: here G=(3,7/3) and O=(3,1.7); moreover, in a right triangle the circumcenter is the midpoint of the hypotenuse, not the right-angle vertex.

The meet/move sequence presents the universal “always/every triangle” conclusion on the basis of a restricted animation C(t)=C+t(B-A), without a general derivation or an explicit statement that the animation is only an intuition.
